import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    private static long[] p = new long[17];

    public static long computeCost(long number, int maxLen) {
        if (p[1] == 0) {
            p[1] = 11;
            for (int i = 2; i < 17; ++i) {
                p[i] = p[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
            }
        }
        if (maxLen == 0) return 0;
        long base = p[maxLen];
        long quotient = number / base;
        long remainder = number % base;
        long cost = quotient * maxLen;
        if (remainder != 0) {
            long optionA = computeCost(remainder, maxLen - 1);
            long optionB = maxLen + computeCost(base - remainder, maxLen - 1);
            cost += Math.min(optionA, optionB);
        }
        return cost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(computeCost(n, 16));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
